title: Establish the outcome of an interrupted recorded update
actor: An engineer responsible for an interrupted recording operation
goal: Read the coherent current outcome after interruption without replaying decisions or rolling back committed work.
context: An ordinary record update or its response was interrupted, so the actor does not know whether its supplied decision committed.
trigger: The engineer inspects the selected Change before deciding whether further work is needed.
preconditions: The engineer supplies the associated project and selected Change; no ordinary recovery action is invented.

interaction.action: Requests current context after an interrupted update.
Lets the storage engine establish its committed/uncommitted outcome and reads a coherent snapshot without semantic replay.
Reports the current state and established revision, or explicit unavailability with safe limitations.
Reconciles the actual state and decides any new authorized action using a fresh revision.

expected_outcome: The actor can distinguish established current state from unknown commitment; committed work is preserved and inspection supplies no new decision or approval.

alternatives.condition: The interrupted transaction did not commit.
alternatives.outcome: The coherent prior state remains authoritative; retry is a new explicit decision using current context.

alternatives.condition: The transaction committed but its response was lost.
alternatives.outcome: Inspection exposes the committed state; it is not rolled back or duplicated to repair missing output.

failures.condition: Store recovery or integrity cannot establish a supported coherent snapshot.
failures.outcome: Report safe unavailability; do not replace the store, guess a repair or overwrite foreign content.

failures.condition: Inspection is interrupted or a concurrent operation prevents a current snapshot.
failures.outcome: Report only the established busy/unavailable outcome; a later fresh read may retry inspection without replaying semantic decisions.
